newsitem.title: UK: Sri Lanka plans $50 mln three-year FRN -dealers.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka plans $50 mln three-year FRN -dealers.

text.p: Sri Lanka plans to launch a $50 million three-year floating-rate note in the first quarter, syndicate managers said on Friday.
"A Sri Lankan FRN is expected in late February or early March," a banker familiar with the transaction said.
He said Citibank and ING Barings were joint lead managers. Officials at Citibank were not immediately available, and ING officials declined to comment.
Dealers said Sri Lanka was likely to hold investor presentations for the offering in February.
